name: Phase 94 Structured Organizer Tools and Multi-Action Creation Manual UI Evidence

testedInteractions: Renders multi-action proposal cards grouped by planId in sequential step order (Step 1, Step 2, etc.)
Displays destination, dependencies ('Depends on Step N'), effects, and status badges ('Local Draft', 'Saved', 'Skipped', 'Failed')
Provides quick propose action buttons (+ Routine, + Event, + Folder, + Section, + Expense, + Multi-Plan)
Allows inline editing for all 9 operations: routine title/recurrence, calendar event startAt/title, folder name, custom section title, and expense amount/currency
Revalidates edited payload via client.updateAiProposal, rotating confirmation_token to ensure approval of reviewed changes only
Batch confirms multi-action plan via client.batchConfirmAiProposals via 'Confirm All Reviewed' button
Displays step outcomes with green 'Saved' chips and red/amber 'Skipped' chips when prerequisites fail
Provides direct 'Open Created Item' deep link buttons to /routines, /calendar, /library, /ledger, and /sections

accessibilityAttributes.keyboardNavigation: All proposal cards, input fields, step actions, and batch confirmation buttons accessible via keyboard Tab and Enter
accessibilityAttributes.contrast: Conforms to WCAG AA on light and dark themes using tokens

testedInteractions: Renders multi-action sequence display inside ScrollView with step index badges (e.g. 'Step 1 of 2')
Displays dependency indicators and status chips ('Local Draft', 'Saved', 'Skipped', 'Failed')
Provides Quick Propose chips (+ Routine, + Event, + Folder, + Section, + Expense, + Plan) for rapid scenario testing
Renders editable TextInput fields for titles, recurrence, timestamps, amounts, and currencies in edit mode
Executes batch confirmation via 'Confirm All Reviewed' button with per-item feedback
Provides direct deep link buttons on saved proposals navigating to specific organizer sections via onOpenSource

accessibilityAttributes.touchTargetMin: Meets 48dp minimum for all mobile action buttons and quick chips
accessibilityAttributes.screenReaderLabels: Full accessibilityLabel coverage on all multi-action step controls
